note: BH-10199 (slice 1): settings row lane.blocked-resolver.gh_source_issues. Where hold_read (bin/lib/hold-push.sh, br_hold_gate and its siblings) reads a ticket's issue and comments: off = GitHub only (today's reads); shadow (default) = the issue record and GitHub, the lane acts on GitHub, logs one PRR_SHADOW line (key <repo>#<n>@thread) in logs/prr-shadow.log when they differ, and writes GitHub's answer back into the record; record = the issue record (bin/lib/issue-record.sh), 0 GitHub calls on a hit, and a miss reads GitHub, logs PRR_MISS and writes the answer back. Any other value is shadow plus one PRR_STEP line. The lane's GH_SOURCE step off makes this off too (off = no record read at all). Separate from GH_SOURCE (the discovery reads). Move to record only after a 48-hour shadow count of 0 (docs/notes/2026-11-27-BH-10199-issue-record.md).
